Date: 2025-05-29 5405.155768
PATENT APPLICATION REMARKSThis paper is in response to the Notice to File Corrected Application Papers dated April 1, 2024. In the Notice, it was noted that a lead line had no reference number in Fig.4.As indicated above, Applicant has amended the drawings. No new matter is entered with these amendments. Entry and acceptance of same is requested.In view of the foregoing, all of the issues raised in the Notice to File Corrected Application Papers are believed to have been addressed.The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees which may be required to this application under 37 C.F.R. §§ 1.16-1.17, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 07-2069.Should the Examiner discover there are remaining issues which may be resolved by a telephone interview, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney at (312) 987-2927.Respectfully submitted, GREER, BURNS & CRAIN, LTD./PATRICK J. SMITH/By Patrick J. Smith Registration No. 65,626 29 May 2025 200 West Madison Stret, Suite 2100 Chicago, Illinois 60606 (312) 987-2927 Customer No. 24978 3
